requirements.text: The system shall require users to authenticate with a unique username and password.
The system shall implement two levels of access: Administrator (full access) and Teacher/Assistant (limited access).
Teachers and assistants shall be restricted to entering/editing child comments and arrival/departure times.
Administrators shall have full read/write access to all system data, including reports and invoices.
The system shall track child arrival and departure times to calculate late pick-up fees.
The system shall support automated monthly billing with logic for multiple-child discounts and late pick-up fees.
The system shall maintain a waiting list for up to 100 potential customers.
The system shall provide a daily reminder feature for all employees with pop-up notifications.
The system shall store immunization records and display alerts when a child is within two weeks of a required immunization.
The system shall generate reports including Customer Directory, Enrollment, Birthday, Cross-Reference, Registration, Immunization, Withdrawal, and Account Activity.
The system shall enforce a maximum capacity of 20 children per classroom.
Passwords shall be 6 to 8 alphanumeric characters in length.
The system shall lock out users after three unsuccessful login attempts.
The system shall log the user ID, date, time, and description of changes made to any account.
The system shall respond to all user requests within 20 seconds.
The system shall provide a web-based interface compatible with Internet Explorer and Netscape Navigator.
The background color of all system windows shall be blue.
The system shall be built using Microsoft ASP.NET.
